detail.longDescription: After a summer of pilot research, I'm going to apply for a grant from the NSF to research accessible game development. This is a long process, but I'm told a good first step is to send a one-page description to the program officer for feedback. You'll find a link to my draft in the next post. I invite feedback from this community. Are their gaping holes in my plan? Am I wasting time doing something that has already been done? # GameDev # research # blind # accessibility # a11y # BlindGamer 1/2
